items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: I've got to get Hazel back.

ctx.x: Was he in good shape that day?
Yeah, one of a few times. Yeah, one of a few times. I should be on my way. Well, even so soon. Soon? I've got to get Lenny back to the job. I've got to get Hazel back. Excuse me.
How many trombones would you use here?
